title: Mechanism and Communication Co-Design for Differentially Private Energy Sharing
summary: Integrating distributed energy resources (DERs) is a critical step toward addressing the global climate crisis. This transformation has driven the transition from traditional consumers to prosumers and given rise to new energy sharing business models. Existing works have extensively studied prosumer energy sharing mechanisms, yet little attention has been paid to privacy protection, particularly when communication constraints are taken into account.
